issues: The supplied verses identify the dream’s first-person narrator as Lehi (1 Nephi 8:2), not Nephi. Scene 007 labels the narrator as Nephi and treats the Nephi seen at the river’s head as someone observed; do not depict two Nephis. The source explicitly names Sariah, Sam, and Nephi there.

The note directing Nephi to voice the first-person narration assigns the observer's speech to the wrong person. The observer names Nephi among those he sees in 1 Nephi 8:14, and the preceding scene identifies the observer as Lehi.
The observer is referred to only as “he” in these verses. The preceding scene identifies Lehi as the one recounting the vision, but the supplied wording here does not explicitly name the observer.
